glosses: Used in various other more-or-less idiomatic ways to construe individual verbs, indicating various semantic relationships such as target, purpose, result, etc.; see also the entries for individual phrasal verbs, e.g. ask for, look for, stand for, etc.

examples.text: to account for one's whereabouts    to care for a relative    to settle for second best    to allow for mistakes

glosses: To, the particle for marking the following verb as an infinitive.

examples.text: “'Ugh—I'll not be able for get up. Send for M'sieu le Curé—I'll be goin' for die for sure.'
